scope: repair stage only; end-to-end unchanged at four arms

cost_reporting: SSC and EVID request counts are not matched; each arm reports actual requests, tokens and fee estimate from the ledger.
scoring: unchanged evaluate.py definitions (display_match OR exec_match; fixed 400 denominator; UNKNOWN separate)
primary_comparisons: repair round2 numeric400 SSC vs EVID36
repair round2 mixed400 SSC vs EVID36
statistics: exact paired McNemar; Holm over the four primary comparisons; source-stratified table-cluster bootstrap for intervals
deviation_note: This file is not part of the v1 freeze hash set. It records a repair-stage design change made before the repair stage started, so v1 initial and e2e evidence stays valid and untouched.
